name: Cowpea plant
group: Plants > Vegetable plants > The seeds or pods

features.claim: The cowpea plant can be short and bushy, as short as 20 cm.
features.quote: Cowpeas can either be short and bushy (as short as 20 cm or 8 in) or act like a vine by climbing supports or trailing along the ground (to a height of 2 m or 6 ft 7 in).

features.claim: The cowpea plant can also grow like a vine, climbing supports or trailing along the ground up to 2 m high.
features.quote: Cowpeas can either be short and bushy (as short as 20 cm or 8 in) or act like a vine by climbing supports or trailing along the ground (to a height of 2 m or 6 ft 7 in).

features.claim: It can stand upright, be partly trailing, or climb.
features.quote: It can be erect, semierect (trailing), or climbing.

features.claim: It has long stalks, 20 to 50 cm, that hold the flowers and seed pods.
features.quote: Another distinguishing feature of cowpeas is the long 20–50 cm (8–20 in) peduncles, which hold the flowers and seed pods.

features.claim: One of these stalks can hold four or more seed pods.
features.quote: One peduncle can support four or more seed pods.

features.claim: Its flowers come in shades of purple, pink, yellow, white and blue.
features.quote: Flower colour varies through different shades of purple, pink, yellow, and white and blue.
A pod can contain six to 13 seeds that are usually kidney-shaped, although the seeds become more spherical the more restricted they are within the pod.

features.claim: A pod holds six to 13 seeds.
features.quote: A pod can contain six to 13 seeds that are usually kidney-shaped, although the seeds become more spherical the more restricted they are within the pod.

features.claim: Its seeds can be white, cream, green, red, brown or black, or a mix of these.
features.quote: Colours include white, cream, green, red, brown, and black, or various combinations.

features.claim: Its seeds can have a smooth or rough coat and be speckled, mottled or blotchy.
features.quote: They can have a smooth or rough coat and be speckled, mottled, or blotchy.

features.claim: Its leaves vary greatly in size and shape.
features.quote: The size and shape of the leaves vary greatly, making this an important feature for classifying and distinguishing cowpea varieties.

debated.claim: Cultivated cowpea pods can be anywhere from 10 to 110 cm long.
debated.quote: Seeds and seed pods from wild cowpeas are very small, whereas cultivated varieties can have pods between 10 and 110 cm (4 and 43 in) long.

second_reading.claim: Its taproot can go down 2.4 m into the soil.
second_reading.quote: The taproot can penetrate to a depth of 2.4 m (7 ft 10 in) after eight weeks.
